main_measure.name: slope of 3-bar forward return minus coin's mean 3-bar return on depth post_pipeline_value (grid bars with non-zero forecast)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting check passes); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; |t| < 2 inconclusive; < 100 grid cases

supporting_check.name: mean unusual 3-bar move in the short direction (minus coin drift) > 0

decided_by: The slope's |t| is below 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Profile taken from the recorded regime ('unknown' = not vetoed to chop, the detector's components are not recorded) and depth from last_history_value; the t is an OLS slope t with standard errors clustered by UTC calendar day (small-sample factor G/(G-1)*(n-1)/(n-2)); the coin's mean 3-bar return is over its non-overlapping grid of all bars of all windows; the 100-case minimum counts grid cases with a non-zero forecast and a full 3-bar forward return.
